title: Korean-Style Oven-Roasted Mackerel Jjigae
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of Korea with the richness of oven-roasted mackerel. This spicy jjigae is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Season mackerel fillets with salt and pepper.
In a large oven-safe skillet, heat sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Sear mackerel fillets for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer to a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
In the same skillet, add gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and garlic.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Add zucchini and bell peppers to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Garnish with green onions and serve with roasted mackerel on top.
